source_blend: Pig/SK_Pig.blend (contains the high-poly bake source PigHigh, hidden)
slot_note: Same four slot names as the asset it replaces. MI_Pig_Skin, MI_Pig_Muzzle and MI_Pig_Eye read T_Pig_Atlas_* (hooves and dewclaws now sit in MI_Pig_Skin). MI_Pig_HornBristle now carries ONLY the bristle cards and reads T_Pig_BristleCards_BC (alpha) / _N / _ORM: make it a masked or dithered two-sided material that casts NO dynamic shadow (the review renders switch card shadows off; with shadows on, every card prints a dark tick on the skin). The cards carry custom vertex normals copied from the skin: import normals, do not recompute them.
rig_compatibility: Existing 26-bone armature and its four actions (Pig_Idle, Pig_Walk, Pig_Run, Pig_Feed, 30 fps) carried over untouched; rest matrices identical; no bone added or renamed. Mesh rebuilt on 12 Nov 2026 (v2: deep barrel, sagging belly, stout legs, wedge head) and skinned with bone heat (max 4 influences); hooves, eyes rigid; ears and tail weighted to their own bones; bristle cards take the weights of the skin under them. Verified by rendering Walk f6, Run f4 and Feed f7.
importer_notes: One FBX per LOD (Export/<Asset>_LOD0..2.fbx) plus one armature-only FBX per clip, written with the same recipe as the existing creature exporters (metres source, temporary x100 export scene, FBX_SCALE_ALL, Armature wrapper node, no leaf bones). Import each LOD explicitly, as Scripts/import_creature_art.sh does. Normal maps are OpenGL (green up): keep the importer green-channel flip used by the existing creature manifests. ORM = AO/roughness/metallic, linear. SSS map (linear, single channel) is a subsurface weight mask for the creature material; without a subsurface profile the asset still reads, only flatter. Body is about 0.77 m wide, 1.79 m long, 1.0 m to the ear tips: re-measure body_boxes on import, they feed the fitted trunk/head boxes. Validator: UV_OVERLAP is reported because the bristle cards (own texture, own slot) share UV0 space with the atlas; the atlas islands themselves do not overlap (0.03 %).
third_party: polyhaven/brown_mud_02 (diffuse: wet mud layer, box-projected and tinted inside the baked atlas)
polyhaven/mud_cracked_dry_riverbed_002 (diffuse: dry caked mud layer, same use)
status: NOT photoreal at 1 m; a believable muddy farm pig at the game camera in idle, walk and feed. Round 3 (12 Nov): weights, form, 3D mud, ears, eyes and foreleg stance reworked.
known_weaknesses: Run: the barrel now keeps its shape, but in the gathered frames the hind legs still fold far forward under the belly and pass through its sagging underside; that is the clip, not the weights.

Skin at 1 m is still too even: pores and wrinkle normal are there but faint under the bristle sheen; the neck rolls read as regular ribs; sunburn on the back is weak, the pink sits mostly on snout and legs.

Bristles: read as a pale sheen and a spiky topline at 3 m as asked, but at 1 m individual cards on the neck are visible as straight white needles, and from the game camera they give the back a slightly frosted, brushed look.
Dirt patches on the back are same-sized soft grey-brown blotches (camouflage-like). Mud crust is convincing on the legs and belly; flank splashes are sparse.
Back view: the hams read as two flat panels with a crease between them; the rump is heavily dirt-covered and dark compared with the flanks.
Ears: still a saturated terracotta when the sun is behind them, thick-rimmed, no hair fringe (not done).
Eyes: iris, sclera and pupil are now visible but the eye is slightly bulging and round, lids are thin rims; lashes are barely visible.
Snout: wet mud on the lower disc is still a noisy green-brown patch; nostrils shallow.
LODs judged by eye at the game camera (final_lods.png): LOD1 holds; LOD2 loses the eye and thins the legs but keeps the silhouette and colour.
LOD0 is 17,626 triangles (soft 15k, hard 30k). Validator: UV_OVERLAP (bristle cards over the atlas UV space, intended); open edges (cards).
round3_changes: Barrel weights: thigh/arm influence is confined to the leg columns and handed to pelvis/spine elsewhere (carry_barrel in pig.py), so the run no longer balloons the hindquarters; every second frame of all four clips was rendered as strips. Forelegs rebuilt straighter in the mesh only (rig and clips untouched; front hooves stay rigid on hand_*). Shoulder and ham masses, flank hollows, stronger spine ridge and hip points in the sculpt. Mud is displaced geometry (4-10 mm crust) with baked cracks and wet gloss low down; dung is 34 displaced clumps with smears. Ears lower on the skull without the mound, thinner subsurface. Eyes: larger ball with sclera, red corner, brown iris, pupil; pale lash cards. 2,200 pale bristle cards.
